title: Guadalajara Cathedral
axis: Positive X runs from Plaza Guadalajara through the basilica toward Plaza de la Liberación. Positive Z points south toward the separately mapped Sagrario.

mappedIdentity.name: Guadalajara Cathedral
mappedIdentity.address: Avenida Alcalde 10, Centro, Guadalajara, Jalisco, México

features.role: Mapped cathedral basilica and connected east end, excluding the separately identified Sagrario

identityStatus: The named mapped building and the large neighboring Sagrario form two separate polygons. The western frontage, east attachment, plaza orientation and tower setting are fixed by the mapped cathedral ring and both photographs.

terrainContact.basis: Unmodified Plaza Guadalajara elevation immediately west of the principal cathedral entrance.

notes: The 2016 UNAM geotechnical study reports the different heights and 12 metre structural base widths of the two towers. The Secretariat of Culture identifies the modern replacement spires. The diocesan text establishes the basilican three-nave plan. Two public-domain views establish the spires and western facade details.
